source_memory.name: Source Memory Gate

agents.claim: Daily-life comedy is active, but rejected lanes must stay excluded.
agents.recommendation: Avoid adult-voice, car/passenger, parcel, fight logistics, chores, food/chai, and perfect-husband rescue.

source_memory.summary: Used successful-carousel standard, Calm Enough for Your Chaos, viral analysis, and the idea ledger.
debate_records: Unknown Number Adult Voice was rejected as underfleshed and excluded.

creative_room.name: Continuous Carousel Agent Room

agents.claim: The countdown gives the deck a natural escalation engine.
agents.objection: It must not become payment, shopping, or tech-help content.
agents.recommendation: Use harmless app verification and focus on the two-person panic.

agents.claim: The idea passes only if both partners fail and recover together.
agents.objection: A perfect-husband reading the OTP for her would fail.
agents.recommendation: Let his finger cover a digit and make him part of the problem.

agents.claim: 30 seconds -> jaldi bolo -> 8/3 -> expired -> resend -> submitted is a strong ladder.
agents.recommendation: Slide 5 must be a reset, not a repeat of slide 1.

agents.claim: Mini mission-control with two phones can carry the whole joke visually.
agents.recommendation: Use large simplified screen states and keep faces/hands readable.

creative_room.summary: Selected OTP Expired Twice after repairing copy and visual blocking.
debate_records: Battery/charger routes were rejected for rescue/object-first drift.
Adult-voice route was rejected for weak escalation.
OTP won because countdown pressure creates action, failure, reset, and payoff.
repairs: Slide 1 changed from OTP sent to 30 seconds.
Slide 5 changed from again to resend. breathe.
Final line changed to two people panicking correctly.
Visual system moved to cozy home mini mission-control.

exploration_routes.name: OTP Expired Twice
exploration_routes.story_lens: Small pressure turns both partners into a working two-person panic system.
exploration_routes.reader_mirror: Every couple has done unnecessary emergency behavior over a tiny app timer.
exploration_routes.emotional_obstacle: The timer makes a normal task feel urgent, and the first failure could become blame.
exploration_routes.aachu_specific_spark: She reacts fast, dramatic, and fully invested in the 30-second countdown.
exploration_routes.zuv_active_role: He reads, misreads, resets, leans in, and participates rather than rescuing.
exploration_routes.proof_engine: 30-second timer, unclear digit, expired state, resend reset, submitted checkmark.
exploration_routes.emotional_reversal: Failure becomes teamwork, and panic becomes shared rhythm.
exploration_routes.distribution_reason: Highly taggable for partners who have turned OTPs, logins, and small app tasks into missions.

stage_scene_gate.action: A harmless 30-second OTP starts a tiny home mission.
stage_scene_gate.reaction: Aachu types fast while Zuv reads too calmly, then both freeze over one unclear digit.
stage_scene_gate.eye_line_or_attention: Their eye-lines move between the two phones and each other, proving shared pressure.
stage_scene_gate.hands_or_object_movement: Two phones move closer together; his finger tracks digits, her thumb freezes, then both hands reset side by side.
stage_scene_gate.silence_or_pause: The expired screen creates a deadpan pause before the resend.
stage_scene_gate.consequence: The first attempt fails, forcing them into closer teamwork.
stage_scene_gate.reversal_or_payoff: The ordinary task becomes a funny relationship proof: two people panicking correctly.

exploration_routes.name: Pause-Frame Blackmail
exploration_routes.story_lens: Paused TV catches one terrible face and becomes a private joke.
exploration_routes.reader_mirror: Couples save bad screenshots and never let each other live them down.
exploration_routes.emotional_obstacle: The joke can become one-sided teasing if not mutual.
exploration_routes.aachu_specific_spark: She spots the ridiculous pause first and tries to save it.
exploration_routes.zuv_active_role: He dives for the remote, then laughs with her.
exploration_routes.proof_engine: Paused TV face, phone camera, cushion block, photo already taken.
exploration_routes.distribution_reason: Funny and visual, but less tender than OTP.

exploration_routes.name: Reel Inbox Audit
exploration_routes.story_lens: She sends reels all day; he reacts to the wrong part and gets audited.
exploration_routes.reader_mirror: Many couples communicate through reels and reaction policing.
exploration_routes.emotional_obstacle: It can drift into phone-addiction if not anchored in affection.
exploration_routes.aachu_specific_spark: She knows exactly which second mattered.
exploration_routes.proof_engine: 18 reels, wrong emoji, 'watch till end', corrected reaction.
exploration_routes.distribution_reason: Very current but more phone-native than scene-native.

exploration_routes.name: Family Video Call Tripod
exploration_routes.story_lens: A family call turns them into each other's tripod and background rescue team.
exploration_routes.reader_mirror: Every couple has scrambled to fit both faces into one call.
exploration_routes.emotional_obstacle: Risk of becoming only a phone-angle joke.
exploration_routes.aachu_specific_spark: She wants both of them to look presentable instantly.
exploration_routes.zuv_active_role: He balances the phone and rescues the frame.
exploration_routes.proof_engine: Dono dikho, bad angle, arm tripod, background rescue.
exploration_routes.emotional_reversal: Awkward public call becomes private teamwork.
exploration_routes.distribution_reason: Strong but less fresh than the OTP countdown.

exploration_routes.name: Voice Search Vs Hinglish
exploration_routes.story_lens: Smart TV misunderstands both of them until they overpronounce together.
exploration_routes.reader_mirror: Home tech fails become couple comedy.
exploration_routes.emotional_obstacle: The machine can become the lead character.
exploration_routes.zuv_active_role: He joins the overpronunciation instead of judging it.
exploration_routes.proof_engine: Remote mic, wrong search result, exaggerated pronunciation.

selected_story_lens: A tiny OTP countdown turns into a two-person panic system that works because both people join the same ridiculous pressure.
emotional_machine: harmless timer pressure -> Aachu fast panic -> Zuv too-calm flawed reading -> shared failure -> side-by-side reset -> tiny success -> earned laughter
proof_engine: 30-second timer, misheard 8/3 digit, expired screen, resend reset, submitted checkmark, phones face-down after the crisis.
reader_mirror: Every couple knows a tiny app task that suddenly becomes a household mission.
distribution_reason: The post invites partner tags from couples who have panicked together over OTPs, logins, and small timed tasks.

human_story_setup.cold_reader_doorway: 30-second OTP timer panic is instantly recognizable daily life.
human_story_setup.emotional_obstacle: Small pressure can become blame or irritation unless both people enter the same rhythm.
human_story_setup.visible_human_proof: The first attempt expires because they misread one digit, then the second attempt works only after they move closer and coordinate.
human_story_setup.active_partner_role: Zuv reads, misreads, resets, leans in, and helps complete the second attempt as a participant, not a rescuer.
human_story_setup.emotional_turn: The expired screen turns from failure into teamwork.
human_story_setup.shareable_setup: The line gives viewers a way to tag the person who panics correctly with them.

success_definition.audience_success: A cold viewer recognizes the exact OTP countdown panic and tags the partner who has lived this tiny household mission.
success_definition.creative_success: The deck works silently as action, reaction, failure, reset, tiny victory, and earned laugh before the final line.
success_definition.brand_success: Warm desi daily-life relationship IP where ordinary tech pressure becomes evidence of shared rhythm, not perfect-husband rescue.
success_definition.production_success: C-layer handoff has native 4:5 and separate native 9:16 prompts, identity inputs, visual gates, and proof-first recommendation before final images.
